notes: Content findings below describe content the blocked retrieval agent(s) cannot currently reach.

findings.evidence: robots.txt line 40: Disallow: / applies to Claude-SearchBot (retrieval-time AI crawler). robots.txt line 110: Disallow: / applies to Claude-User (retrieval-time AI crawler). robots.txt line 110: Disallow: / applies to Claude-Web (retrieval-time AI crawler). robots.txt line 110: Disallow: / applies to Meta-ExternalFetcher (retrieval-time AI crawler). robots.txt line 110: Disallow: / applies to Perplexity-User (retrieval-time AI crawler). robots.txt line 40: Disallow: / applies to PerplexityBot (retrieval-time AI crawler).

suggested_action.summary: Narrow the Disallow rule to the paths that actually need protection rather than the site root for: Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, Claude-Web, Meta-ExternalFetcher, Perplexity-User, PerplexityBot.

findings.title: Retrieval-time AI crawler blocked at root

findings.evidence: Site-wide: 5 sampled pages share this defect. Page  1 accessibility violation(s): unlabelled form control.

suggested_action.summary: Add lang, descriptive alt text, accessible names for controls, and labels for all form inputs.

findings.title: Machine-detectable accessibility violations

findings.evidence: Page https://www.verywellhealth.com/health-insurance-company-wont-pay-3231743: 5 accessibility violation(s): missing alt on a non-decorative image; missing alt on a non-decorative image; missing alt on a non-decorative image; missing alt on a non-decorative image; unlabelled form control.

suggested_action.summary: Add lang, descriptive alt text, accessible names for controls, and labels for all form inputs.

findings.title: Machine-detectable accessibility violations

findings.evidence: Page https://www.verywellhealth.com/: no <h1> element found, so the page states no primary topic. Violates WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships).

suggested_action.summary: Add exactly one <h1> naming the page's primary topic.

findings.title: Missing landmark or heading structure

findings.evidence: Site-wide: 6 sampled pages share this defect. Page  heading level skip detected. Violates structural conventions (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1).

suggested_action.summary: Add <main> to wrap primary content; fix heading level skips.

findings.title: Missing landmark or heading structure

suggested_action.summary: Add or complete an Organization JSON-LD block with at minimum 'name' and 'url'.
Repair the link's target or replace it; add a 301 redirect if the target is genuinely gone.

recommendations.title: Images/iframes missing dimensions (layout-shift cause)
recommendations.rationale: 7 image(s)/iframe(s) lack explicit width/height or aspect-ratio, so content reflows during load.

suggested_action.summary: Add width/height attributes or CSS aspect-ratio to reserve layout space before the resource loads. (Proactive — not a confirmed defect.)

limitations.reason: Actual agreement across the wider web about the brand's facts requires a search or web-scale index API. No free, deterministic, rate-safe source exists.
limitations.note: CHK-D-025/026/027 audit only the anchoring the site itself provides for that corroboration, not corroboration itself.

limitations.reason: Detecting a same-name collision with an unrelated entity requires a corpus of other entities.
limitations.note: CHK-D-027 covers only self-consistency, the site-side half.

limitations.reason: Live-querying a generative engine would break determinism, the 5-minute budget, and reproducibility.
limitations.note: This audit measures retrievability and correctness of what the site exposes, never observed citation outcomes.

limitations.reason: Field engagement outcomes (bounce, dwell, scroll, conversion, task success) are not observable read-only.
limitations.note: Reported not_determinable where the gap is itself actionable.

limitations.reason: llms.txt is not recommended as a substantive fix: a 137k-domain measurement found 97% of existing llms.txt files were never requested. This audit declines to recommend adding one on that evidence (D-007).
limitations.note: Stated here rather than omitted (D-014) — the officials' Q&A confirms recommending it is an acceptable position, so silence about it would look indistinguishable from having missed it.
